preconditions.description: The length of s is at least 2, the length of t is at most half the length of s, and the scissors' parameter k is at most half the length of s.

preconditions.expression: s and t consist of lowercase latin letters
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output indicates whether it is possible to cut s to form a string containing t as a substring.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes', then two integers L and R are provided such that 1 <= L <= R <= n - m + 1
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the two integers L and R denote the starting indexes of the two substrings cut from s to form the resulting string containing t.
